svg.title: Liveness ROC curve
svg.desc: Live is the positive class. The marked operating point uses the saved validation threshold.

g.text: held-out evaluation by image path/content; evaluation subject separation cannot be verified
False positive rate: spoof accepted as live (APCER)
True positive rate: live accepted (1 - BPCER)
Threshold fixed from validation; no calibration or threshold selection on this evaluation manifest.
